items.issue: Wall-time gain is noise level: HEAD 55.18 s against 56.99 s pre-change on the same machine (about 3%), against a stated 40 s target. The remaining time is dominated by the python child process each test spawns.
items.reason: Resolved against the PRD text: it requires only that wall time drops from the 65 s baseline, calls the under-40 s figure a guess, and states the per-test python child processes stay. Both the must-have and the success criterion are met. Cutting the child-process spawn cost is excluded by this PRD and deferred as a candidate for its own PRD; the in-scope part (per-test submodule builds still present) is fixed by this cycle rework task.
